description: TOML parse. A TOML document in, URL-encoded as the toml query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), a parsed document out: the full nested config as JSON (tables, dotted keys, arrays of tables, inline tables, strings, integers in all four radices, floats, booleans, RFC 3339 datetimes), the type counts, and every finding with its line number (malformed lines, duplicate keys and tables, unclosed strings and arrays, trailing content). Price: $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

toml.description: The TOML document to parse (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: toml-parse
